//Jwt: DEVELOPMENT ONLY. This key is committed so the stack runs with one command.
Production reads Jwt:SigningKey from Key Vault. The API refuses to start outside
Development if this literal value is still in use — see JwtOptionsValidator.
//Admin: DEVELOPMENT ONLY. There is no self-service path to the Admin role, so without a seeded
account nobody can grant the first instructor and the Studio cards cannot be exercised.
This file is only read in Development. In Azure, Admin:Email and Admin:Password come
from Key Vault, and AdminSeeder does nothing at all when either is absent — there is no
default password anywhere in the code. See 04-adr-authentication.md section 7.
